name: HD Lighting Demo Place
summary: Original native lighting demonstration place with a baseplate/spawn, two Atmosphere instances, two Sky instances, four Bloom effects, two ColorCorrection effects, four DepthOfField effects, eight Blur effects and six SunRays effects. Also contains a Pistol Tool under Lighting.Tools, with seven embedded weapon scripts; this is not a clean lighting-only model.
install: Open the .rbxl as a separate place in Studio. Inspect LIGHTING-SETTINGS.json and Lighting properties. For integration, copy only the reviewed Lighting effects and desired property values into your own Lighting service. Review duplicate skies/atmospheres and enabled states rather than blindly stacking them. Do not copy Lighting.Tools or its Pistol into your game merely to install the lighting. A .rbxl is a place, not an insertable model.
limits: Visual lighting preview only; no quality/performance or device certification. Duplicate effects and inactive blur states are retained exactly as supplied. The unrelated Pistol DamageHandler trusts client-supplied target/damage and EventCatcher accepts client positions without validation/rate limiting; do not deploy those weapon scripts. The pistol, weapon animations, sounds and damage were not exercised. Static screenshots show combined lighting, not isolated proof of every effect or animation.
credit: Supplied filename HD-Lighting.rbxl. Original lighting/weapon authors are not independently established; original scripts and dependency references are preserved.
test: Opened the actual native place and inspected Lighting through Studio MCP. Recorded effect names, enabled states and principal properties. Limited Play check spawned the local character on the baseplate; the Backpack was empty and Lighting retained 31 children. The pistol remained in Lighting.Tools and was not equipped. Captures are 685 x 634 Edit-mode views at the supplied clock time, not alternate lighting presets. No changes saved to the original.
